HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
p

We are currently seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as a Corporate Services Manager. The job holder is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the Corporate Services department at HSBC M Square Branch and as well as other corporate branches.
q: Strong knowledge of local and regional cash management with proven track record in Client Services.
Good knowledge and direct experience of service provision and how customer service impacts client perception.

Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Excellent time management, planning and organisation skills
Excellent range of communication skills, including written, verbal, and the ability to deliver compelling presentations

A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and/or work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.

Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager - Waste Operations to lead reliable, efficient and compliant waste collection services across Qiddiya City. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on operational leadership with a focus on recycling, service quality and a seamless visitor experience at a destination bringing entertainment, sports and culture together.
p
Lead daily operations: Plan collection routes, schedules, shifts and capacity around asset operating hours, waste volumes, access restrictions and peak events.
p
Manage contractor performance: Monitor delivery against agreed scopes, service-level agreements and KPIs, resolve service failures and drive corrective action.
p
Maintain service readiness: Oversee collection-point records, bin capacity and condition, vehicle and equipment availability, staffing and contingency arrangements.
p
Support recycling and segregation: Coordinate segregated collections and delivery to approved recycling, treatment or disposal facilities, maintaining the required operational documentation.
p
Coordinate across city teams: Establish clear collection interfaces, access arrangements and handovers, including readiness for new asset openings.
p
Respond to operational issues: Coordinate responses to missed collections, spills, equipment outages and waste accumulation through approved escalation procedures.
p
Drive efficiency and accountability: Track service completion, waste quantities, recycling recovery, complaints and cost per tonne; monitor expenditure and validate contractor invoices.
p
Champion safe, compliant delivery: Implement approved environmental and health and safety procedures, support team training and maintain auditable records.
q: A bachelor's degree in Environmental Management, Engineering, Operations Management or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification supported by substantial waste operations experience.
At least 8 years of relevant waste management or collection operations experience, including 3 years in a supervisory or management role overseeing service teams or contractors.

Hands-on experience managing multi-site waste collection, communal or central bin locations, contractors and receiving-facility interfaces within a city, municipality, large estate or mixed-use destination.
Strong capabilities in collection planning, route optimization, fleet and workforce coordination, contractor management and operational inspections.
Experience in service mobilisation, peak-demand planning, segregation and recycling, operational compliance, KPI reporting and cost control.
Clear communication, stakeholder coordination and data analysis skills, supported by knowledge of applicable waste and environmental requirements.

SRT Marine Systems plc (SRT) are a market leader in its domain of international marine surveillance technology and systems. We are respected, established and an ambitious multi-national company headquartered in the UK with a global customer base.
p

The company has a global impact in the marine domain by leading the next generation of Maritime Domain Awareness 'MDA' technologies, products and systems that significantly enhance, security, safety and environment protection and sustainability. Our customers are worldwide and range from the largest national coast guards to individual vessel owners.
p

SRT is an exciting company where high-quality results are rewarded. We are ambitious and are constantly seeking to innovate to deliver better products and services to our customers. We strive to make SRT a rewarding and challenging place to work where talented hard-working individuals have the opportunity to make a real impact across the marine world.
p

You as our Senior Construction Director will work on SRT projects in the Middle East region. This is an extremely hands-on, site-facing role supporting the Programme Director by leading project delivery, coordinating assigned workstreams, and controlling delivery against agreed scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk and customer commitments.
p
Role Overview of our Senior Construction Director
p

The Senior Construction Director will coordinate ICP, design consultants, subcontractors and internal SRT teams through design development, construction readiness, installation and acceptance. The role will also act as design manager/coordinator during design development, overseeing the ICP design consultant and managing design reviews, comment close-out, approvals and alignment with SRT technical requirements, customer obligations and site delivery constraints. This is an extremely "Hands-on" role and the expectation is for a majority of time to be spent on each of our project sites.
q: Strong, proven experience in project management and delivery of complex construction and system integration projects, including construction delivery interfaces on complex multi-site programmes
Experience of civil build, construction and design for communication towers, data centres etc. would prove highly beneficial
Experience of international build, construction and design knowledge would prove highly beneficial

Experience working with in-country partners, design consultants, customer-side stakeholders, government/regulatory stakeholders and local subcontractors in the Middle East or comparable international delivery environments
Ability to review and challenge contractor programmes, identify schedule risk, support recovery planning and translate programme issues into practical site actions
Strong capability in managing design clarifications, technical deviations, approval dependencies, procurement interfaces and installation-readiness constraints

Experience acting as a design manager, design coordinator or client-side design lead, including management of consultant deliverables, design review trackers, technical queries, comment close-out and approval workflows
Strong working knowledge of project governance, integrated planning, RAID management, change control, progress reporting, stakeholder management and commercial delivery awareness

Experience supporting a Programme Director or equivalent senior delivery leader by consolidating delivery reporting, escalating risks and ensuring project execution remains aligned to programme objectives
Comfortable operating in an extremely hands-on, site-based capacity, with the flexibility to travel regularly across Middle East for extended periods as project delivery requires
IT Literate (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Project Schedule software including P6 and MSP, CAD)
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to adjust communication style to suit customers, partners and internal teams

Lead assigned projects and workstreams, ensuring delivery remains focused on scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and customer outcomes
li
Maintain project governance, including delivery reviews, action tracking, decision logs, escalation routes, reporting cycles and customer-facing progress forums
li
Oversee integrated planning, schedules, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, RAID, change control and delivery forecasts
li
Coordinate in-country delivery across customer, government, regulatory, ICP, consultant, subcontractor and internal SRT interfaces
li
Maintain a regular site presence across in-country site locations, travelling frequently to project locations to review progress, resolve blockers and confirm construction and installation readiness
li

Act as design manager/coordinator during design development, overseeing ICP design consultant deliverables, review cycles, comment responses, approval submissions and alignment with SRT / customer requirements
li
Coordinate design workshops and reviews between SRT technical teams, the Programme Director, ICP, consultants, customers and site delivery teams
li
Manage design queries, technical clarifications, deviations, approvals, procurement dependencies and installation-readiness constraints
li
Ensure construction and design activities comply with applicable in-country health, safety, environmental and statutory requirements
li
Assist with tender activity, scope interpretation and delivery advice as required

Support provided if your family wishes to join you in-country
